savings.reason: No final residual conclusion approved while first-end and inventory judgments remain incomplete. Read original administrative/travel provisions and EO:13316; neither a private-right disclaimer nor ordinary compensation provisions by themselves establish an independent continuing command. Accrued rights are distinct from continuing authority.

research_rationale: Section 6(b) ends the Commission at the earlier of 30 days after actual report submission and August 30, 2003. No actual submission date is held. July 31, 2003 is only the report deadline; August 30 is an outside bound and cannot establish the earliest end without resolving the submission trigger. Full original and actor contexts, own terms, earlier chain and all machine search scopes were read. EO:13316 section 3 expressly revokes this named order; section 6 confirms September 30, 2003 effectiveness, rather than its September 17 signing date. Its introductory reference to committees already terminated or whose work is complete does not identify an earlier termination date. Machine label Sec. 2 and partial-scope flags are segmentation metadata errors: the operative text is section 3, and this named item revokes the order in full. A source match is not a finding of the earliest ending. Provisional no status is preserved.

review_notes.search_assessment: Read all three search scopes and hit counts. The OFR catalog covers 6,938 post-1937 records and 7,619 saved EO texts; all assigned orders fall within that period. The eCFR/CFR search is point-in-time through 2026-10-14 across 49 titles. The USC search covers 58 title files only through 2026-10-09 and expressly omits the final five days of the legal cutoff. These searches are useful bounded EO/regulatory leads, but contain no report-submission evidence and do not search non-EO presidential extension instruments. Counts are not source text. No search IDs are selected while material closure remains unsupported.

effective_date_confirmation.reason: EO:13316 section 6 explicitly applies to this order and its section 3 revocations.

review_notes.inventory_assessment: Machine spans were compared with the complete original. Retained as review leads, not approved: structural lead-ins are separate rows and first-end distinctions within amended or conditional provisions remain unresolved. No boundary correction is asserted.
